newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BEAL STEPS IN, GUSCOTT RECALLED.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BEAL STEPS IN, GUSCOTT RECALLED.

text.p: Jeremy Guscott earns a swift recall as a winger in an adjusted back division against Argentina at Twickenham on Saturday after losing out in the centre shoot-out against Italy last month to new captain Phil de Glanville and old leader Will Carling.

Carling and de Glanville stay in midfield but coach Jack Rowell gets round the Carling-Guscott dilemma by taking advantage of an injury to Adedayo Adebayo to put Guscott on the wing after 45 caps as centre since 1989.
So Rowell will not need to choose again between Guscott and Carling, who have been England centres in 43 Tests together , until the Five Nations Championship in February.
Tony Underwood's hopes of a recall on the wing in his specialist position have been dashed.
Northampton's Nick Beal becomes the eighth new England cap in just two matches this season when he deputises for concussed full-back Tim Stimpson.
Beal has developed markedly since 1993 when he was rated a sevens expert _ he was England's goalkicker when they won the World Cup Sevens at Murrayfield that year.

N Beal (Northampton); J Sleightholme (Bath), W Carling (Harlequins), P de Glanville (Bath, capt), J Guscott (Bath); M Catt (Bath), A Gomarsall (Wasps); G Rowntree (Leicester), M Regan (Bristol), J Leonard (Harlequins), S Shaw (Bristol), M Johnson (Leicester), T Rodber (Northampton), C Sheasby (Wasps), L Dallaglio (Wasps).
Replacements: J Callard (Bath), A King (Wasps), K Bracken (Saracens), R Hardwick (Coventry), P Greening (Gloucester), B Clarke (Richmond).
